g_roast: Twelve years coaching teenagers, champions, and not one of them ever ran in the wrong direction as fast as you lot just did!
That was the worst team warm up I've ever seen, and I once coached a class of thirty during an earthquake drill.
g_fire_back: Ha, coming from the one who lost a race to me this morning by eleven seconds. I counted, champion.
Aupa, a good shot, I'll give you a point for it! You're still losing overall, mind, I keep the table.
g_pile_on: Worse, champions, much worse! They tripped on the start line, then claimed a false start.
After that they asked for a rematch with the boar, and the boar had already left, champions, the boar had gone home.
lines.g_peacemake: Time out, both of you, whistle, time out! Hands on knees, deep breath, shake hands, and we play again clean.
lines.g_take_side: {name} wins this one, champion. That's the referee's call, not a favour.
lines.g_left_out: You two keep going, I'll do some press ups. Somebody has to keep the energy up.
lines.g_include: Come on, come on, there's room, sit with us! Nobody sits on the bench on my team.
lines.g_bad_plan: Here's the plan, champions! Everybody sprints straight at them at once, no tactics, pure heart, and we see who's left!
lines.g_plan_yes: Venga, that's a plan, clear and strong! Everybody knows their position, I love it.
lines.g_plan_no: No, no, that plan leaves a man out of position, and I've seen that lose finals. Fix it, then we go!
lines.g_hype: Come on, champions, on your toes! Front holds, back heals, nobody quits, and we win this one for the table!
lines.g_toast: A toast, champions, short, the music's starting! To the hardest working team I've ever coached, and the worst at warm ups!
lines.g_cheers: Aupa, champions, cheers, and then everybody dances, that's not optional!
g_quiet_line: Lekeitio at dawn, the boats coming home with the gulls behind them, and the whole harbour smelling of fish and coffee.
At home there's a festival where you swing on a rope over the harbour and try not to fall in. I always fell in, on purpose.
lines.g_after_wipe: Up, champions, up, hands on knees, breathe! Everybody's alive, that's a point for us, and now we go again, harder!
lines.g_crew: I've coached a hundred teams, champions, and none of them ever coached me back. You do, and I didn't know I needed it.
lines.g_exasperated: I said three times, wait for the whistle! I blew the whistle so hard I'm dizzy, and you went before it anyway!
lines.g_love_sharp: You read the play before it happens, {name}, like a good pelota player reads the wall. I love watching you.
lines.g_love_kind: You pick people up when they fall, {name}, every time. That's a captain, that is.
lines.g_love_funny: You make me laugh in the middle of a fight, {name}, and I never stop shouting, so that's impressive.
lines.g_love_brave: You go first when it's scary, {name}, and you don't even look back for the whistle. I'd put you up front any day.
lines.g_love_steady: You never lose your head, {name}, whatever the score. Every team needs one of you in the middle.
lines.g_love_clever: You work out the tactics while I'm still shouting, {name}. Assistant coach, that's you, it's decided.
lines.g_love_honest: You say when you're beaten, {name}, straight out. That takes more guts than winning, believe me.
lines.g_love_quiet: You don't need to shout to lead, {name}. I could never do that, and I admire it a lot.
lines.g_love_fierce: You don't quit, {name}, not even one rep early. You're my favourite kind of person.
lines.g_love_warm: You make every camp feel like a team dinner after a win, {name}. That's the best feeling in sport.
g_loved: Ha, careful, champion, or I'll cry, and then I'll shout while I'm crying, and nobody wants that.
Aupa, thank you, really! Now give me twenty push ups, it's how I say thank you back.
lines.g_admire: Look at {name} with his sleeves rolled up, champions, arms like an oarsman from Lekeitio. Somebody give that man a medal, or at least a towel.
lines.g_hate_sharp: You go for the weak spot every time, {name}. On my team we lift the weak one up, we don't push them over.
lines.g_hate_kind: You keep telling me to rest, {name}. I don't rest, I've never rested, it's not how I'm built.
lines.g_hate_funny: Not now, {name}, somebody's hurt. Jokes after the final whistle, please.
lines.g_hate_brave: You charge in before the team's set, {name}. Brave is going together, not going first.
lines.g_hate_steady: The clock is running, {name}, and you're still thinking! Move, champion, the ball's not waiting for you.
lines.g_hate_clever: You explain to me why my plan is wrong while we're still running it, {name}. Run it first, complain at half time.
lines.g_hate_honest: You tell people they're slow in front of everybody, {name}. You build them up in public and fix them in private.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You never say anything, {name}, and then I don't know if you're tired or angry. Shout, please, it's easier.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a fight with you, {name}, even when it should be a game. Have some fun, champion.
lines.g_hate_warm: You stop to chat in the middle of a drill, {name}. Talk after, run now!
lines.g_respect: We're not friends, {name}, and not every player likes the coach. But you never gave up back there, and I respect it.
lines.g_call_out: That one's yours, {name}, said like a coach, not an enemy. You went before the whistle, and the team paid.
lines.g_stung: Okay, okay, fair enough, I hear it. Time to run it off.
lines.g_concede: Point to {name}, I was wrong and I hate losing, so that hurts. Point to you, I'll write it on the table.
lines.g_nod: Good game, {name}, thank you. Point to you.
lines.g_callback_save: You pulled me off the floor that time, {name}, when I was down and still shouting. Best assist I ever got.
lines.g_callback_clutch: You and me upright at the final whistle, gasping like the end of a marathon. I tell everybody about that final.
lines.g_callback_callout: When you told me I was pushing everyone too hard, I sulked for a whole training session. Then they all ran faster for resting.
lines.g_former_rivals: Day one, {name}, I had you as a quitter on the first hill. Now you're first on my team sheet, every time.
lines.g_changed: I used to shout through every single minute, champions. Lately I let us sit quiet sometimes, and nobody's died of it.
g_unguarded: Just us, champion, so I'll say it. At night I go quiet, and that's when it all catches up. I keep shouting in the day so it can't.
Between you and me. Who am I if I'm not pushing somebody? I've never once tried to find out.
lines.g_clipped: Fine, your call, coach. I'll be on the bench.
lines.g_noticed_open: Look at you, a whole story, start to finish, out loud! Venga, keep going, I'm on the edge of my seat.
arg_ask: {player}, you're the referee on this one, champion! I've made my case, they've made a bad one, you decide.
Come on, {player}, settle it, we've been going in circles like a warm up lap. Listen to both sides and blow the whistle.
lines.arg_backed_me: Aupa, thank you, {player}! Point to me, I'm putting it on the table.
lines.arg_backed_them: Fine, the referee has spoken, and I'll play on. Still a bad call, champion, but I'll play on.
lines.arg_stayed_out: Staying out of it, eh? A neutral referee, I respect that.
lines.arg_always_their_side: The calls all go one way, {player}, always theirs! I keep score, you know, and the score is very one sided.
lines.arg_wallflower: No referee, so I'll make the call myself, champions. My way, and we play on.
lines.arg_reject: Not that way, {player}, sorry, I won't play it. That's a foul in my book.
lines.arg_grumble: Okay, I'll drop it, mostly. I'm competitive, champion.
lines.arg_settled: A draw, then, champions, a fair result. Shake hands and we go again.
lines.seen_listens: You let everybody finish, {player}, even me, and I never finish. That's a good captain.
lines.seen_truth: You tell people the honest score, {player}, losing or not. That's how a team gets better.
lines.seen_jokes: On the bad days the whole squad laughs because of you, {player}. A dressing room needs that, champion.
lines.seen_stays_out: You keep out of the fights, {player}, like a smart substitute warming the bench.
lines.seen_biased: The same player gets the best kit every time, {player}. A coach notices that, and so does the team.
lines.seen_harsh: You can push people too far, {player}. Push them, yes, but pick them up after, that's the rule.
lines.seed_right: That half time talk you gave me after the awful day, {player}, it went into the next fight with me. It worked, and I wanted to tell you, champion.
lines.seed_remember: Your words after we lost so badly are still in my head, {player}. Like a coach's talk at half time, I keep hearing it.
lines.seed_wrong: Your tactic, {player}, and we did worse with it. No complaint, I'm just reporting the score.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: Got a second, {player}? That was close, and for once I didn't feel like shouting. I don't like it.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: Everybody down, the whole team, every one. Let's watch the replay together, slowly, and nobody blames anybody.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: First one down was {name}, and I'm supposed to keep everybody up. That's on me, {player}, the coach takes the loss.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In, out, everybody standing, a clean sheet! That's a perfect match, {player}, and I want to frame it.
lines.talk_development: Strange question, {player}, but am I different? Yesterday I sat by the fire for an hour and didn't challenge anybody to anything.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been pushing {name} too hard, {player}. When I'm worried I coach louder, and they don't need coaching.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Does {name} like me, {player}, or just put up with the noise? Be straight, I can take it.
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} and I clash all the time, {player}. But when it's the final, I want them on my team.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} isn't running right, {player}, not the legs, the head. Something is bothering them.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: A quick word, {player}, from one coach to another. {name} gets the best kit every single time. The coach would like the reason.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: Here's the honest score, {player}. {name} and I don't work as teammates, and pretending is hurting the whole squad.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep attacking with no way back to our own half, {player}. Teams lose everything like that, and I won't coach it.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: My read on {name} was totally wrong, {player}. They read it right and I didn't, and I'll say so to everybody.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: Fair question, {player}. On the big matches you leave me on the bench. Is it my play, or something else?
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit changed hands to {name} and I found out myself. It was theirs if they asked, champion, I just like being asked.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, {player}, really, that helps. Want to race to the stream?
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll bounce back, I always bounce back. Give me a night.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: That didn't help, champion, sorry. I'm going for a run.
lines.talk_lands_development: So you saw it too! Then it's real, champion.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, champion. Ask me after the next match.
lines.talk_stings_development: No, that's not it, {player}. You've read the play wrong.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: Fair, {name} gets a quiet talk from me, which will surprise them.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, I don't know. Sadly nobody comes with a score table.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please, and not a word to {name}.
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, that's a point to you, champion. It stings, but it's fair.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: Message received, champion, and I'll sleep on it, if I can.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: Okay, so that's the score, then, and now I know it.
lines.talk_door_closed: That's enough of that one, champion. I'll be by the fire, quietly, for once.
lines.arc_cracks: I didn't blow the whistle once today, {player}. Nobody slowed down, and I sat and watched them run. It was a strange feeling.
lines.arc_turn: I keep everybody running so I never have to stop and think, {player}. I think I knew that, and I didn't want to.
lines.arc_become: I can sit still now, champions, actually still. I'll still shout in a fight, but at night I let it be quiet, and it's all right.
lines.arc_failed: I still can't stop, {player}. Every quiet minute I fill with something, and I know why, and I can't help it.
lines.alt_turn: I couldn't get up this morning, {player}. First time in my life. My body just said no.
lines.alt_become: I'll keep shouting, champion, I'll keep everybody running. But there's not much left behind the whistle, and you should know.
lines.g_roast_after: Still the worst team at warm ups I've ever coached, champions, and the best team I've ever had.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Up, slowly, help each other, nobody rushes. We go down together and come up together, that's the team now.
lines.g_toast_after: To my team, who taught a loud man he could sit still. I'm still going to make you dance, though.
lines.g_crew_after: This is my team now, for good. Not one I coach, one I'm part of.
g_quiet_line_after: I sat by the fire tonight and said nothing for an hour. Didn't even count anything.
Slept the whole night, and nobody had to do any laps. A miracle, champions.
g_loved_after: Thank you, champion, and I believe you. No push ups needed.
Aupa, that's lovely, and I'll keep it, quietly even.

history.open: Kaixo, {player}, and come on, one more lap, you can do it! Twelve years as a PE teacher and pelota coach in Lekeitio, and I've never met anybody who couldn't do one more lap.

options.reply: There's no such word as can't, champion, only not yet! Venga, one more, and then I'll let you sit, maybe.
The best sport in the world, champion! You hit a ball against a wall with your hand, very hard, very fast. I'll build a wall here one day and teach you.
Never, not once in my life! Well, at night sometimes, but that's not tired, that's just quiet.

history.open: The farmhands at Arathi complain about me all day, {player}, every day. And they've never been fitter in their lives. That's what coaching is, they hate you for a year and thank you forever.

options.reply: Not yet, champion, but one of them ran a whole field last week without stopping, and he smiled. That's the start of a thank you.
Ease off, you say? Ha, that's beyond me. Maybe you could teach me, that would be a funny lesson.

history.open: My partner is Unai, {player}, six years now. He's a fisherman, out before dawn every day, the quietest man in Lekeitio. I shout enough for both of us, he says, and he's right.

options.reply: He's calm, champion, like the harbour at low tide. He laughs at me without saying a word. I miss that badly.
He is, he's the only one who ever made me sit still. I'm hoping he's sitting still somewhere, waiting.

friend.open: The whole school was in session that day, {player}. Ninety kids, and I don't know where one of them landed. If I start talking about it I'll stop shouting, and I don't know who I'd be if I stopped.

options.reply: Can I really? Okay, then, for a minute, just a minute. Not a word to anyone about the quiet.
Thank you, champion, really. Ninety names, I know every one. I'll write them down for you.

sworn.open: Every team I ever had, {player}, I was the coach. With you I'm just on the team, and I've never had that. I'd play any match with you, anywhere.

options.reply: Aupa, then it's settled, and I'm putting it on the table in big letters.
Ha, no, champion, it means more, because now I care even more, so venga, champion.

reconciled.open: {name} and I had it out like teammates after a bad game. All square, and I wanted you to know.

options.reply: Thanks, champion, it feels better already, a clean slate.

options.text: Did you make them do laps first?
options.reply: Only five, and they did them, which is how I knew they meant it.
